fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced facility (continuous chain-link perimeter confirmed in 6+ Street-View frames). Only public road touching the property; US-50 to the south is limited-access with no driveway.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred true at medium confidence: major 24/7 Target regional DC (~600 staff, $61.8M volume per chamber data), fully fenced, with a small checkpoint structure at the south yard edge (~38.2768,-104.4666). The north entrance apron in 2022 imagery is open to the road with the security gate/booth set back inside; top-down resolution did not crisply isolate the booth, hence medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ — dock banks on the building's east face (trailers backed in along the full east wall) and a long south-face dock bank; estimated ~120 doors total across both faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ — extensive trailer drop/storage yard on the east and SE with many double rows of parked trailers; 200+ trailers visible in z18-z20 imagery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock clusters (east-face bank and south-face bank) suggest separate ship/receive operations; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Entry/exit share one wide apron; estimated ~2 in / 2 out from apron width. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance apron and large paved staging area inside the gate — ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is the BNSF/UP main line along US-50 corridor but it does not serve the site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-Pueblo industrial site surrounded by open scrub/farmland; classified Rural.
